items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: Rod Fleeman, the guitar player from Dry Jack, I just talked to him three or four days ago

ctx.x: Yeah it was mostly by ear. I mean I did write the stuff down you know, and made a, it was an effort for me because I learned to play by ear and you know, going back to really crack the code of exactly what I’m writing, you know, in sixteenth notes and — I really had to study that. But not that we used the charts, but I wanted to have it documented somehow and I still have those charts, it’s really funny to look at, you know, the scrawl. But yeah, we just — Rod Fleeman, the guitar player from Dry Jack, I just…
Did your parents support your endeavors or did they think — was there ever any talk about getting a real job?
